commands.name: list-section-news
commands.summary: List the latest stories (articles, videos, live pages) on a top-level BBC section page such as news, sport, business or technology.

commands.name: list-subsection-news
commands.summary: List the latest stories on a BBC sub-section page, e.g. technology/artificial-intelligence.

commands.name: list-region-news
commands.summary: List the latest BBC News stories for a world region (Europe, Asia, Africa, ...).

commands.name: list-topic-articles
commands.summary: List stories tagged with a BBC News topic (e.g. France), paginated.

commands.name: get-article
commands.summary: Get a BBC News article's metadata: headline, description, author, publish/modify dates, image.

commands.name: get-video
commands.summary: Get a BBC News video page: title, description, publish time and related video links.

commands.name: get-live-blog
commands.summary: Get a BBC live blog page: title, description and latest update time.

commands.name: list-live-pages
commands.summary: List the BBC live blogs currently running (news and sport), from the /live index.

commands.name: list-football-scores
commands.summary: List football matches (scores and fixtures, all competitions) on a given date.

commands.name: list-team-fixtures
commands.summary: List a football team's recent results and upcoming fixtures.

commands.name: get-league-table
commands.summary: Get the current standings table for a football competition.

commands.name: search-football-teams
commands.summary: Find football teams and competitions by name. Returns BBC URNs and scores-fixtures URLs (the team slug is in the URL).

commands.name: list-tv-schedule
commands.summary: List the BBC News TV channel programme schedule (titles, synopses, start times) for a country feed.

commands.name: get-page-content
commands.summary: Get structured JSON content for a BBC page path (e.g. a /reel/video/{id}/watch video): title, summary, publish times, metadata.

commands.name: get-media-streams
commands.summary: Resolve a BBC media PID into playable stream URLs (HLS video renditions and thumbnails).
